Predicates:
Feud(x, y) ::: x has a feud with y.
Includes(x, y) ::: x includes y.
Leads(x, y) ::: x leads y.
FormedIn(x, y) ::: x was formed in y.
Stable(x) ::: x is a professional wrestling stable.
Person(x) ::: x is a person.
IvyNile(x) ::: x is Ivy Nile.
CreedBrothers(x) ::: x is the Creed Brothers.
DiamondMine(x) ::: x is Diamond Mine.
Imperium(x) ::: x is Imperium.
RoderickStrong(x) ::: x is Roderick Strong.

Premises:
FormedIn(DiamondMine, WWE) ::: Diamond Mine is formed in WWE.
Leads(RoderickStrong, DiamondMine) ::: Roderick Strong leads Diamond Mine.
Includes(DiamondMine, CreedBrothers) ::: Diamond Mine includes the Creed Brothers.
Includes(DiamondMine, IvyNile) ::: Diamond Mine includes Ivy Nile.
Feud(Imperium, DiamondMine) ::: Imperium has a feud with Diamond Mine.

Conclusion:
¬Feud(Imperium, x) ::: Imperium does not have a feud with a professional wrestling stable that includes Ivy Nile.
